shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore && echo ---- && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs && echo ---- && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ | head -100

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/lab node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -iE '^Chevron(Left|Right)\.' ; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | grep '"version"'; timeout 20 npm view @gravity-ui/date-components version 2>&1 | tail -3

grep -E '"@gravity-ui/(date|uikit)' package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/esm/components/; sed -n 1,200p node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts; sed -n 1,80p node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/esm/components/Calendar/index.d.ts; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/esm/components/Calendar/
D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components && ls $D && cat $D/package.json | sed -n 1,60p && find $D -maxdepth 4 -iname 'Calendar*.d.ts' | head && find $D -maxdepth 3 -name '*.css' | head

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm && ls $D $D/components && cat $D/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts && sed -n 1,80p $D/components/Calendar/index.d.ts; grep -n 'css' $D/components/Calendar/Calendar.js | head; grep -n -iE 'import.*css|styles' $D/index.js | head

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm && cat $D/components/CalendarView/hooks/useCalendarState.d.ts | sed -n 1,80p; echo ----; grep -n -E 'export (declare )?(const|function) (dateTime|dateTimeParse|settings)' -r node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build | head

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm && cat $D/components/types/index.d.ts | grep -n -A12 'ValueBase'; grep -n -B2 -A20 'CalendarStateOptionsBase' $D/components/CalendarView/hooks/types.d.ts | head -60; echo ----; sed -n 1,40p node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/dateTime/dateTime.d.ts; grep -n -A6 'interface PublicSettings' -r node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/settings/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/index.d.ts
rm -rf dist && git status --short && (which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; node -e "require.resolve('playwright')" 2>&1 | head -1)
